answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 50567 Country: India Title: Accountant Job Question: Basically, I am an accountant. One of my friends is doing marketing business. His products are halal items like chocolates etc but his whole investment is from bank loan. Is it ok for me to work with him as a part time accountant for his income tax purpose and can I get a salary for that? Answer ID: 50567 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 283/250/D=03/1435) It is lawful to work as an account for income tax and derive salary for the same. Your job and salary shall be alright, no matter if the person has taken loan from the bank. However, he shall be sinful due to interest based loan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
